responsibility: This file provides out-of-line support code for GCC’s vec dynamic-array abstraction. It owns vector memory-accounting structures and reporting, the shared allocation-growth heuristic used when resizing vectors, runtime checking helpers for comparator correctness in vec sorting, and CHECKING_P selftests covering construction, push/grow, insertion, truncation, removal, sorting, reversal, and auto-delete behavior, complementing the mostly inline container implementation in vec.h.
same_name_distinction: Holds the out-of-line support for GCC’s vec container, including memory-accounting/reporting, the shared growth heuristic, comparator-checking helpers, and selftests; gcc/vec.h contains the primary vec template family and most inline container operations.
